name: EffectInformation
description: Represents various animation options for an Effect object.
remarks: Use the members of the EffectInformation object to return the current state of an Effect object, such as the after effect, whether the background animates along with its corresponding text, whether text animates in reverse, play settings, sound effects, text building behavior. All of the members of the EffectInformation object are read-only. To change any effect information properties, you must use the methods of the corresponding Sequence object. Use the EffectInformationproperty of the Effect object to return an EffectInformation object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: AfterEffect
properties.description: Returns an PpAfterEffect constant that indicates whether an after effect appears dimmed, hidden, or unchanged after it runs. Read-only.

properties.name: AnimateBackground
properties.description: Returns msoTrue if the specified effect is a background animation. Read-only.

properties.name: AnimateTextInReverse
properties.description: Determines whether the specified shape is built in reverse order. Applies only to shapes (such as shapes containing lists) that can be built in more than one step. Read/write.

properties.name: BuildByLevelEffect
properties.description: Determines the level of the animation build effect. Read-only.

properties.name: Dim
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color to dim to after an animation is finished.

properties.name: PlaySettings
properties.description: Returns a PlaySettings object that contains information about how the specified media clip plays during a slide show. Read-only.

properties.name: SoundEffect
properties.description: Returns a SoundEffect object that represents the sound to be played during the transition to the specified slide. Read-only.

properties.name: TextUnitEffect
properties.description: Indicates whether the text in the specified shape is animated paragraph by paragraph, word by word, or letter by letter. Read-only.
